basics.name: ELhachmi Salah
basics.title: Senior Android Developer
basics.summary: Highly skilled Android Developer with 11 years of experience. Solid understanding of the full mobile development life cycle with hands-on expertise with a wide variety of Android device resolutions and SDK versions. Dedicated to continuously discovering, evaluating, and implementing new technologies to maximize development efficiency. Experienced in most popular programming languages and Frameworks involved in Android development such as Java, Kotlin, Dart and Flutter. Has good knowledge and experience in Front-End and Back-End development using Spring Boot, ReactJs.

work_experience.description: Development of digital assets wallet as Android app, that allows users to instant transfer, store, build and grow their portfolio of assets in a single application.
achievements: Built digital assets wallet Android application from scratch using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
Implemented instant transfer and portfolio management features with real-time updates
Integrated secure authentication and biometric login for asset protection
Achieved 99.5% crash-free rate with comprehensive error handling

work_experience.description: Development of a mobile payment Android app (tPay by Tayara), that enables users to send and receive money, pay bills, etc.
achievements: Developed tPay mobile payment Android application serving 50K+ users
Implemented money transfer (send/receive) functionality with bank API integration
Built bill payment features supporting multiple service providers
Migrated codebase from Java to Kotlin, improving code quality by 40%

work_experience.description: Developed an Android application offered to WHO (World Health Organization) agents providing the possibility to register information about hospitals such as GPS location, Name, Address, Specialty, etc.
achievements: Built Android app for WHO (World Health Organization) agents deployed across 3 countries
Implemented hospital information registration system with offline-first architecture
Integrated GPS location tracking for hospital mapping with custom map overlays
Designed and implemented RESTful API consumption layer using Retrofit and RxJava
